name: K-Spot Now Page Design System
mission: Keep the public site visitor-facing, visually intentional, and consistent without forcing every page into the same hero layout.

tokens.name: Brand coral
tokens.note: Top page eyebrows and key brand accent.

tokens.name: Muted
tokens.note: Secondary text, never page identity labels.

tokens.name: Touch target
tokens.note: Buttons, tabs, save controls, and map links.

reviewRules: Visitor pages hide RSS and JSON jargon
Each page type has a distinct purpose
Home spotlight uses swipeable dots, not numbered sequence labels
Home event gallery starts short and expands on request
Calendar starts with current or upcoming planning months
Typography uses a modern service font with multilingual fallbacks
Role council reviews changes before execution
Detail mobile hero media keeps card gutters visible

governanceLoop.purpose: Turn design criticism into repeatable work: find defects, debate intent and feasibility, review before execution, implement, then evaluate again.

roles.label: 책임총괄
roles.scope: Collects findings, ranks priority, decides block/schedule/approve, and keeps the loop moving.

roles.label: 디자이너
roles.scope: Owns visual intent, hierarchy, typography, interaction feel, and whether the page looks desirable to use.

roles.label: 개발자
roles.scope: Owns implementation, responsive behavior, accessibility targets, build health, and regression checks.

roles.label: 자문단
roles.scope: Challenges visitor usefulness, monetization fit, copy clarity, and whether a feature belongs on the page.

roles.label: 감사
roles.scope: Finds visual defects, clipped text, overflow, awkward spacing, broken controls, and missing verification evidence.

roles.label: 유저평가단
roles.scope: Reads the result like a first-time visitor and reports whether the UI feels obvious, polished, and worth using.

stages: 책임총괄이 발견된 문제와 해야 할 일을 한 줄 작업으로 정리한다.
디자이너와 개발자가 의도, 구현 난이도, 위험, 대안을 서로 답한다.
자문단과 감사가 실행 전에 고객 가치와 품질 리스크를 검토한다.
개발자는 승인된 항목만 구현하고 빌드, 검증, 스크린샷을 남긴다.
유저평가단은 결과 화면을 다시 보고 직관성, 매력, 완성도를 평가한다.
책임총괄은 다음 반복에서 고칠 항목과 보류할 항목을 결정한다.

heroTypes.name: Product Entry
heroTypes.purpose: The first screen should prove the service is useful through event discovery, imagery, city/category entry points, and clear actions.
avoid: Internal source explainers before visitor listings

heroTypes.name: Utility Page
heroTypes.purpose: Tool-like pages should open quickly, keep the title restrained, then let filters, lists, or route cards carry the value.

heroTypes.name: Workspace Tool
heroTypes.purpose: Planner must feel like a usable saved-event board with a visual preview, utility shortcuts, and starter actions.

heroTypes.name: City Landing
heroTypes.purpose: City pages should show place identity first, then lead into representative events and scannable city filters.
avoid: Awkward line breaks in city titles
Event lists with no city signal

heroTypes.name: Detail Decision
heroTypes.purpose: Event detail pages should help visitors decide quickly: date, place, source handoff, weather, map, and nearby route context.
avoid: Affiliate blocks that compete with event facts

heroTypes.name: Identity Page
heroTypes.purpose: Trust pages should show the service identity, mark, and principles with enough visual presence to feel intentional.

pages.title: Home
pages.watch: Hero scale, gallery scan, city/category entry points.

pages.title: Home Events
pages.contract: Event cards start as a concise browsing surface and expand only when visitors ask for more.
pages.watch: Search/filter density, initial card count, load-more affordance, card rhythm.

pages.title: Now
pages.contract: Urgency reads as status flags, not text headings.
pages.watch: Live/ending flags, card rhythm, no internal feed jargon.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.contract: Date navigation is calm, consistent, and utility-first.
pages.watch: Eyebrow color, filters, month heading scale.

pages.title: Planner
pages.contract: Saved-board tool feels distinct without becoming a homepage clone.
pages.watch: Hero size, preview panel, button quality, empty state.

pages.title: Guides
pages.contract: Guides feel like practical visitor help, not passive documentation.
pages.watch: Guide card density, title scale, and quick usefulness.

pages.title: Routes
pages.contract: Route cards lead; ads stay peripheral.
pages.watch: Left ad rail, route card density, no square ad block.

pages.title: Seoul City
pages.contract: City identity appears before generic event lists.
pages.watch: City title scale, image crop, horizontal city chips.

pages.title: Event Detail
pages.contract: Facts, weather, and source handoff beat explanatory prose.
pages.watch: Fact cards, source handoff, weather module, ad placement.

pages.title: About
pages.contract: Service identity feels intentional and branded.
pages.watch: Logo lockup, K-Spot Now nowrap, principle cards.
